info.title: ToolHub calculation and tool search API
info.description: Read-only Korean calculators from toolhub.ai.kr for AI agents and programs: take-home pay, social insurance, age/zodiac and sunrise/sunset, plus a search over all ToolHub tools. The same tools are available as a remote MCP server at https://toolhub.ai.kr/mcp (Streamable HTTP, no auth). Results use the same code as the web pages (2026 and 2027 Korean rates). All amounts are KRW. No key needed; please cache responses.

get.summary: Find ToolHub pages (calculators, converters, planners, games) for a need

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Keywords in Korean or English, e.g. 연봉 실수령액, 김장 시기, json formatter

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Max results, 1–20 (default 8)

200.description: Matching tools with name, description, category and URL

get.summary: Korean take-home pay (연봉 실수령액) after social insurance and income tax

parameters.name: annual
parameters.description: Gross annual salary in KRW (required unless monthly is given)

parameters.name: monthly
parameters.description: Gross monthly salary in KRW (annual = monthly × 12)

parameters.name: nonTaxable
parameters.description: Monthly non-taxable pay such as meals (default 200000)

parameters.name: dependents
parameters.description: Dependents for withholding, including the employee (1–11, default 1)

parameters.name: children
parameters.description: Children aged 8–20 among dependents (default 0)

parameters.name: year
parameters.description: Social insurance rate year (2026 or 2027; default = year in force)

200.description: Monthly and annual net pay with deduction items, rates and a link to the page

get.summary: Korean social insurance (4대보험) for employee and employer

parameters.name: pay
parameters.description: Gross monthly pay in KRW (required unless annual is given)

parameters.name: annual
parameters.description: Gross annual pay in KRW (pay = annual ÷ 12)

parameters.name: nonTaxable
parameters.description: Monthly non-taxable pay (default 200000)

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: Company size for the employer job-stability premium

parameters.name: accident
parameters.description: Industrial accident rate in percent (default 2026 average 1.47)

parameters.name: year
parameters.description: Rate year (2026 or 2027)

200.description: Monthly premiums by item for employee and employer, totals and labor cost

get.summary: International age (만 나이), year age, Korean zodiac (띠) and elementary school entry year

parameters.name: birth
parameters.description: Birth date YYYY-MM-DD (exact zodiac by Lunar New Year)

parameters.name: year
parameters.description: Birth year, if the date is unknown

parameters.name: on
parameters.description: Reference date YYYY-MM-DD (default today in KST)

200.description: Ages, zodiac (ganzi and animal) and school entry year

get.summary: Sunrise, sunset, solar noon, day length, civil twilight and golden hour in Korea (KST)

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Date YYYY-MM-DD (default today in KST)

parameters.name: city
parameters.description: City id: seoul, incheon, suwon, chuncheon, gangneung, daejeon, sejong, cheongju, cheonan, jeonju, gwangju, mokpo, yeosu, daegu, andong, pohang, ulsan, busan, changwon, jeju, seogwipo (default seoul)

parameters.name: lat
parameters.description: Latitude within Korea (33–39), with lon instead of city

parameters.name: lon
parameters.description: Longitude within Korea (124–132)
